# Lavendar Lewis

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Irving](../character/irving.md) (spouse), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with a fresh, almost girlish face and thick, snow-white hair that is beautifully wavy and arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Her sweet, big eyes are a wood-brown shade featuring little golden glints. Though her hair looks old, her facial features retain a youthful appearance.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis possesses a deeply imaginative nature. She relies heavily on pretending and make-believe as a essential means to cope with life.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis, named after the plant because her father was fond of its scent, lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young servant, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Her life took a turn when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) accidentally stumbled upon her home, leading to a new friendship. Miss Lavendar eventually opened up to [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to introduce Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to her. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) expressed concern over Miss Lavendar's melancholy, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped arrange a reunion between Miss Lavendar and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md). The couple successfully reconciled, and after a month of preparations, Miss Lavendar married [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) in her garden before departing with him.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +262 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "About your age I think. He ought to be older because I dreamed him long before you were born. But I’ll never let him get any older than eleven or twelve; because if I did some day he might grow up altogether and then I’d lose him."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar Lewis first meets [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) accidentally lose their way in the woods and end up at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). They quickly become very dear intimate friends and kindred spirits, sharing pleasant evenings of stories, tea, and personal confidences. [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps bring happiness back to Miss Lavendar's life by introducing her to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and later helping arrange her romantic reunion with Paul's father.

- Friend of — very dear intimate friends and kindred spirits  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +2 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as the young maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) under Miss Lavendar's employment. She keeps a close eye on her employer, confiding in [Anne](../character/anne.md) when she notices Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior. Together with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) helps prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for both the reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and the subsequent wedding.

- Commands — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar meets [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) when [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) wander off their path and arrive at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for a pretend tea party. [Diana](../character/diana.md) remains a frequent visitor alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), bringing joy to Miss Lavendar's life and later returning to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to assist in preparing for her garden wedding.

- Friend of — frequent visitors who brought joy to her life  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar employs [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) as a young servant at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she exercises authority over her household duties.

- Commands  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) share a long romantic history, having experienced a broken engagement decades prior before reconnecting later in life. After resuming their courtship and walking together again, they commit to one another as husband and wife.

- Romantically involved with — taking a walk together while courting  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — fiancé/husband  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar is introduced to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) through [Anne](../character/anne.md), and the two rapidly develop a warm bond as kindred spirits. They spend memorable time together in her garden sharing imaginative stories, with Miss Lavendar's tales of her imaginary dream-boy deeply connecting with Paul's creative mind.

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar was engaged to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) twenty-five years ago before a rift separated them. After [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) expressing a desire to reconnect, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps facilitate their meeting at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), leading to their full reconciliation, courtship, and ultimate marriage in a garden ceremony.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>
